thm:main.statement: Every closed smooth Riemannian surface has a smooth isometric immersion into Euclidean four-space.
thm:main.conditions: Compact without boundary;positive definite smooth metric;may be empty,disconnected or nonorientable;self-intersections allowed.
thm:main.constants_and_limits: No global injectivity,ambient chord-distance preservation,curvature bound,effective finite solver or approximation rate is asserted.

lem:phase-data.statement: Positive phase-square decomposition with all required sums/differences good for the current second form.
lem:phase-data.conditions: B_F is nonzero as a tensor at every point;reference tensor positive;H in a sufficiently small C0 neighborhood;finite compact phase supports.
lem:phase-data.constants_and_limits: H=sum psi_nu^2*q_nu(H)*dphi_nu^2;strictly positive square-root arguments;nonzero good dphi,2dphi,phi+-phi;successive dominant weights,C2 stability. Not arbitrary prescribed phase directions.

lem:polynomial-phase-data.statement: Varying approximate immersions admit phase data with polynomial geometric bounds.
lem:polynomial-phase-data.conditions: Uniform metric upper/lower bounds,Cj(f_z)=O(z^-j) for j<=3,uniform positive max directional second form;no z-regularity assumed.
lem:polynomial-phase-data.constants_and_limits: Cell diameter comparable z^6,count O(z^-12),cutoff derivatives O(z^-6j),DB=O(z^-4);bounded color/phase-weight count independent of cells;good directions persist in C2 ball z^4. Exponents depend on finite orders;not explicit useful constants.

prop:primitive-addition.statement: Add one positive rank-one metric exactly while preserving later boundary normal and crossing conditions.
prop:primitive-addition.conditions: Closed surface,immersion with nowhere-zero B and preferred global unit normal;amplitude positive exactly on disk and flat outside;positive transverse phase Hessian;pairwise transverse curves,no triples,finite tangencies andnonzero crossing phase evaluations;all ordered Q conditions.
prop:primitive-addition.constants_and_limits: gamma(Fplus)=gamma(F)+a^2 dx^2,B remains nonzero,preferred normal and all later strict invariants retained;arbitrarily small C2 exterior change,but map need not equal old exterior. One normal section,not global oriented normal frame.

prop:small-increment.statement: Finite differential small oscillations approximate a positive metric increment for a perturbed metric map.
prop:small-increment.conditions: Fixed admissible phases and compact nondegenerate 2-jets,H in inner positive ball;P_i polynomial above order2;0<tau<=s<=1,delta/tau and eta=tau/s+epsilon*tau^-p sufficiently small.
prop:small-increment.constants_and_limits: U=O_tau(delta*tau),metric/operator error O_tau(delta*eta^q+delta^3/tau);p=E+6 fixed before arbitrarily large finite q;derivative loss and thresholds may increase with q. Supports original/intersections;not infinite parametrix or full global inverse.

prop:exact-correction.statement: Finite-order approximate isometries with nonzero second form admit exact smooth corrections close in C2.
prop:exact-correction.conditions: Fixed smooth positive hstar;families f_z smooth immersions,Cm=O(z^-m) through R+2,metric error CR=O(z^N),uniform positive second-form norm;no regularity in z required.
prop:exact-correction.constants_and_limits: A permissible R=440,N>20*mu+1 with an unspecified fixed mu>1;z threshold depends on implicit bounds;exact metric and C2=o(1). Infinite blockwise smoothing,not compactly supported correction or known finite runtime.

lem:finite-order-smoothing.statement: Moment-canceling smoothing of sections on a fixed compact bundle atlas.
lem:finite-order-smoothing.conditions: Positive integer r,fixed smooth bundle and atlas;0<s<=s0.
lem:finite-order-smoothing.constants_and_limits: S_s derivative bound s^-m*Cq,approximation s^(r-j)*C(q+r),bounded in each Cm;kernel made from Vandermonde-weighted dilates cancels moments1..r and may have signed values. Not positivity-preserving smoothing.

lem:exact-step.statement: One smoothed increment contracts all fixed observation-order weighted defects from a finite controlled-order input bound.
lem:exact-step.conditions: G in C2 radius z^4/2 around f_z,normalized positive defect near hstar,controlled S_r(k)<=z^-4,k>=10;s=t^1.1,tau=t^1.2,delta=t^k,r=q=40(k+1).
lem:exact-step.constants_and_limits: Apply increment to UNSMOOTHED G;delta'=tau^k or tau^(k+1);S'_m<=||G||C2+||hstar||C0+C_m(z,k)t^1/5(1+S_m). High true derivatives enter linearly;no square of smoothing tail;finite waiting at each k,then k->infinity. Not uniform known number of steps.

lem:velocity-plane.statement: A positive transverse phase Hessian supplies a smooth two-dimensional velocity plane and collar-compatible frame.
lem:velocity-plane.conditions: P=span(G_y,G_yy)^perp;near fixed F with Hess_gamma x(yy)>0,preferred normal and boundary non-antipodality;amplitude a>0 inside.
lem:velocity-plane.constants_and_limits: G_y,G_yy independent;normal-plane projection to P an isomorphism;R0=sqrt(|PG_x|^2+a^2) has positive lower bound;choose e1=normalized PG_x only on collar and normalized Pn inside. PG_x may vanish in interior.

lem:loop-density.statement: Smooth strictly positive time densities realize interior targets in convex hulls of circle-valued paths.
lem:loop-density.conditions: Smooth finite-dimensional family on compact parameter set,target strictly inside convex hull;three mass-and-two-coordinate constraints have rank3.
lem:loop-density.constants_and_limits: avg rho=1,avg rho*p=c;local bumps plus positive floor and smooth partition patch,including prescribed overlapping solution. Reparametrization keeps path,changes dwell time;not arbitrary boundary targets or derivative bounds uniform as margin vanishes.

lem:small-value-derivative.statement: Small-value compactly supported functions can prescribe a large transverse derivative along finitely controlled curves.
lem:small-value-derivative.conditions: Compact K in finite union of embedded curves,no shared arcs,finitely many intersections and vertical tangencies;B>0,epsilon>0.
lem:small-value-derivative.constants_and_limits: h_y=B on K,||h||C0<epsilon,support in any fixed precompact neighborhood. Special-point bumps and thin strips;higher derivatives uncontrolled. Does not permit small C1 norm or arbitrary dense/closed vertical arcs.

lem:velocity-loop.statement: A smooth constant-radius velocity loop has prescribed mean and independently controlled turn derivatives.
lem:velocity-loop.conditions: All primitive-addition hypotheses;fixed finite threshold T chosen after derivative-independent normal bounds;loop depends smoothly onposition and2-jets.
lem:velocity-loop.constants_and_limits: V in P,|V|=R0,avg V=v,w=V-v smoothly zero outside;alpha=hturn+A cos t,positive density reparametrization;two turns and |N0star|>T off boundary collar. Choices fixed before fast z->0;no universal bandwidth or derivative cost.

prop:primitive-realization.statement: A prescribed mean velocity circle produces exact primitive-metric immersions with selected derivative asymptotics.
prop:primitive-realization.conditions: Smooth immersion with everywhere nonzero B;independent Y=G_y,C=G_yy,R0>0;V in P constant norm R0,avg V=PG_x,w flat on support boundary;compact nondegenerate jet neighborhood.
prop:primitive-realization.constants_and_limits: Exact hstar=gamma(F)+a²dx² for all sufficiently small z;fx->X,fy->Y,fyy->C,fxy->X_y with theta held fixed,z fxx->Vtheta;uniform second-form lower bound and exterior C2 convergence. Unscaled fxx need not converge or remain bounded.

lem:finite-periodic-expansion.statement: Finite periodic correctors cancel fast metric fluctuations,leaving mean differential operators and a controlled finite remainder.
lem:finite-periodic-expansion.conditions: Actual constant-radius smooth loop satisfying primitive-realization hypotheses;integer L>=2;zero-mean periodic primitive operator.
lem:finite-periodic-expansion.constants_and_limits: f_z=G+sumj1..L z^j Uj,avg Uj=0;metric=a²dx²+gamma(G)+sumr1..L-1 z^r Er+sumrL..2L z^r Rr;orders Uj<=2j,Er<=2r+2,polynomial in higher jets;flat support. Covariance solve M=I-Sigma/R0² positive even at a=0,when M=I;not a general global inverse of metric linearization.

lem:spherical-preparation.statement: An arbitrary finite set of spherical second-form jets can be flattened with uniform C2 and immersion bounds.
lem:spherical-preparation.conditions: Closed smooth surface,smooth immersion I into unit S3,arbitrary finite P and small epsilon.
lem:spherical-preparation.constants_and_limits: Set spherical B=0 at P,C1 closeness<epsilon,uniform C2 upper and metric lower bounds independent of count/separation. Disjoint quadratic bumps Q_p and renormalization preserve value/first jets;higher derivatives can grow with shrinking supports.

lem:global-preparation.statement: Prepare a finite ordered rank-one deficit decomposition with every actual partial metric phase-convex and boundary crossings admissible.
lem:global-preparation.conditions: Closed smooth surface and smooth positive metric;ordinary Whitney immersion and spherical lift,uniform finite-point preparation;finite atlas and positive cone margins.
lem:global-preparation.constants_and_limits: Choose uniform scale and number of cycles BEFORE crossings;each perturbed cycle uses A_c^-1 and sums exactly h/Nc,C1 partial-cycle perturbation O(1/Nc);choose generic radii/phases by Sard,Fubini,then flatten crossing jets. No explicit useful cycle count or algorithm cost.

Nash1956.scope: Compact positive Ck metric,3<=k<=infinity,admits Ck isometric EMBEDDING in dimension n(3n+11)/2;for surfaces17. It is a higher-dimensional embedding statement,not four-dimensional immersion or a runtime bound.

Whitney1944.scope: Compact partial n-manifold immersion in E^(2n-1),embedding near boundary with separated boundary/interior images;surface case supplies ordinary immersion in R3. No metric equality. Text treats n=2 as known and continues higher-dimensional proof.

Gromov2000.scope: Explicit open question whether every smooth Riemannian surface has smooth isometric immersion into R4. Checked historical question only,not later status or its proof.

Gromov2015.locator: Author version9Oct2015,p4 footnote6 andp59 Cylinders and Tori
Gromov2015.scope: Footnote attributes R4 smooth surface conjecture to Chern around1950 with compactness uncertainty;later text recalls closed-surface R5 constructions in PDR3.2.4. Checked author account,not original PDR proof or any universal algorithm.

Lewicka2026v3.scope: Disk-like planar domain,metric Cr,beta with0<r+beta<=2,strictly short C1 immersion:uniform C1,alpha isometric approximation for alpha<min((r+beta)/2,1). Appendix restates smooth simply connected planar Poznyak theorem. Neither gives closed arbitrary-topology smooth conclusion;original1973 theorem not recovered.

Sard1942.scope: For Cq map of a region in Rm to Rn with m<=n,q>=1,the critical values are m-null;in particular smooth plane-to-plane critical values are Lebesgue-null. F333 uses equal-dimensional parameter projection plus countable charts,not a quantitative separation bound.

Choquet1958.locator: Contemporaneous May1957 Bourbaki account,printedpp140-141,Theorems1-2 and following immersion qualifications
Choquet1958.scope: Strictly short C1 maps in codimension>=1 admit arbitrarily C0-close C1 isometric embeddings,with the text explicitly allowing immersion instead and noncompact/local-tolerance version. No C-infinity preservation or usable curvature bound;Nash/Kuiper originals not separately checked.

Kallen1978.locator: Original Lemmas2.2-2.3 printedpp34-36 andLemma3.3 statement p43/proof pp45-47
Kallen1978.scope: Positive square-form decompositions with smooth coefficient dependence and finite patches;finite amplitude substitutions correct metric error in a low-regularity construction. Supports attribution to decomposition/finite correction;does not supply F333 good-phase sums,selected normal geometry or smooth R4 theorem.
